verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for a SaaS platform like AngelList, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a public API reference or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt file indexes help-center content, not an API reference, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
